name: PROBIT
rule: One breastfeeding-promotion randomized cohort, follow-up reports; not randomized formula assignment.

name: LEAP
rule: Original, follow-up and erratum. Correction is distinct publication, not extra cohort.

name: BLISS
rule: One trial, distinct growth and choking outcomes.

name: WHO motor
rule: Reference study and companion table; no independent efficacy trial.

name: Cornell choline
rule: Original, follow-up and protocol. Protocol has no outcome data.

name: ADORE
rule: Same randomized cohort and post hoc genotype analysis.

name: ORIP
rule: Parent trial and subgroup records; verify original membership.

name: SPRING
rule: Parent cohort and associated reports; product donation and negative findings retained.

name: CHAMACOS
rule: Original and secondary analysis.

name: Phthalate pooled cohorts and ECHO
rule: Partial overlap, not identical populations; no pooled total.

name: UGAAR
rule: Growth and cognitive follow-up.

name: HAPIN
rule: Birthweight and infant stunting follow-up.

name: MATISSE
rule: Trial and label; 90/180-day cumulative endpoints; 99.5% and 97.58% CI retained; HARMONIE separate.

name: iKMC
rule: Same original trial. OMWaNA separate trial; reviews overlap.

name: Pakistan Lady Health Worker
rule: Same original and 4-year follow-up.

name: BABITT
rule: Trial result and protocol; no separate efficacy from protocol.

name: Disposable diaper cues
rule: Methods and result possible same cohort; verify.

name: Colic probiotics
rule: IPD includes trials; not independent aggregate.

name: Calcium
rule: Review versions, commentary, IPD and dose trial; compare membership and outcome.

name: Pregnancy probiotics
rule: Overlapping reviews and trial; eligibility differs; preserve safety signal.

name: Fertility retraction chain
rule: Excluded retracted trials; dependent outcome hold; not all reviews retracted.
